dedupe_keys.name: model america autobem energy simulation output for arizona buildings summer 2022

description: This dataset gives building-by-building energy simulation results for every county in Arizona for summer 2022 (1 June to 31 August), from Oak Ridge National Laboratory's Automatic Building Energy Modeling (AutoBEM) software, which builds and runs energy models of individual buildings on high-performance computers as part of Model America. It was published on Zenodo on 1 February 2025 by Hang Li, Fengqi Li and Joshua New of ORNL, Shovan Chowdhury of the University of Tennessee at Knoxville and Avery Stubbings of the Illinois Institute of Technology, using NASA POWER weather for 2022. For each building it lists descriptors such as footprint, height, area, type, floors, energy code standard and window-to-wall ratio, and simulated electricity and gas use by end use together with heat emitted from surfaces, air leakage and exhaust losses, heat rejection and total anthropogenic heat emissions. Coverage: all Arizona counties, with Maricopa the largest file (about 446 MB). Access: one CSV per county on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: simulated, not metered, for one summer. Simulation uses: building anthropogenic heat for urban heat studies and summer peak demand. Related records: the fTMY future weather files from the same ORNL group and Scout.
